newsitem.title: ITALY: Mediaset to pay '96 195 lire dividend.
newsitem.headline: Mediaset to pay '96 195 lire dividend.

text.p: Italian broadcaster Mediaset will pay a 1996 ordinary dividend of 195 lire per share compared with 1995's dividend of 175 lire, a company source said.
Mediaset is holding its board meeting today to examine 1996 results.
Its shares were 0.05 percent down at 6655 lire in a generally easier market.
